question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the supported generic public Plugin SDK contract for transient tool chrome across plugins?
rationale: The Slack fix needs a cross-plugin typed signal because bundled plugins cannot import each other's internals, but adding permanent public Plugin SDK exports is an owner-controlled compatibility decision rather than a mechanical review choice.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the generic reply-payload marker and predicate, then require the structured Slack block-path repair and focused compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with an existing narrower host or plugin-local seam, accepting additional refactoring before the Slack fix can land.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if maintainers do not want tool-progress intent represented in the shared reply-payload contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic reply-payload marker and predicate, then require the structured Slack block-path repair and focused compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the Slack delivery architecture and the Codex app-server boundary affected by the decision.
